item.jaymoskingdoms.fire_cannon.tip: Hold use to load a blaze rod or blaze powder. A rod is one shot through armour; powder is a blast of fire close in.
item.jaymoskingdoms.field_mortar.tip: Set it on the ground. Use it with a Mortar Shell to load, then use it to fire the way you face. Look up to drop the shell nearer.
message.jaymoskingdoms.avatar.cannon: You tinker too? Then carry what we made down here. A rod to pierce, powder to burn.
death.attack.jaymoskingdoms.fire_lance: %1$s was run through by a burning rod
death.attack.jaymoskingdoms.fire_lance.p: %1$s was run through by %2$s's burning rod
